column1: # source<TAB>target<TAB>context sentence (Narkamaŭka) containing the source word
# Training data for the disambiguator. The label (keep / soft_l / i_to_y / e_to_e /
# particle) is derived from the pair; the context supplies the next-word features
# the particle cases need. Nothing here overlaps the gold set.
# --- soft_l: Western loans with hard л ---
# --- keep: native words with hard л ---
# --- particle: не → ня before first-syllable stress ---
# --- keep: native з/с/г/х/б/п + л clusters the trigger also matches ---
